metadata.title: Opindx: Open Journal Factor, Network Factor and Article Network Score
metadata.description: Complete annual Opindx journal metrics for citation years 2022-2026 from the OpenAlex snapshot of 2026-09-23 and the Norwegian Register list of 2026-07-26. Includes separate annual OJF two-year and NF/ANS five-year datasets in CSV, XLSX and Parquet, journal metadata, raw/filtered scores, dictionaries, release notes, checksums and format validation. OJF uses fixed approved Norwegian Register citing channels and includes journal self-citations. NF/ANS are available for OpenAlex and Norwegian Register calculation universes. Version 2026-09-v4 adds independent OJF data and preserves every prior NF/ANS annual file. All metrics follow a twelve-month maturity policy; 2025/2026 are provisional and 2026 is incomplete. Numerical inputs are OpenAlex (CC0) and the Norwegian Register (NLOD 2.0), with documented author-curated identity corrections. No official journal-level metrics, commercial roster or membership flag is included.
